children: EVI INDUSTRIES, INC. reported full-year 2026 revenue of $446.57M, up 14.6% from $389.83M a year earlier, while net income rose to $7.72M and diluted EPS was $0.48 on the year — results disclosed in the company's 10-K filing.
¹ Reported as “Revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “earnings per share – diluted”.
Revenue growth of about 15% in fiscal 2026 was driven primarily by acquisitions completed in fiscal 2025–2026.
The company expanded into consumer garment care with the acquisition of Sudsies (effective Sept. 1, 2026), creating a new reportable segment.
Management continued a buy-and-build strategy, adding brands including Laundry Pro, O’Dell, Haiges, Girbau, ASN and Belenky to broaden its footprint.
Gross margin improved to 31.5% from 30.4%, attributed to a more favorable product/customer mix and increased emphasis on solution selling.
EVI maintains a broad service network for installation, maintenance and repairs and said it invested in service capabilities and optimization initiatives during the year.
